data.title: Bitmine’s Ethereum Holdings Near $15 Billion After Buying 28,086 More ETH
data.description: Bitmine just loaded up on nearly 30,000 more Ethereum tokens, pushing its treasury toward a staggering size that rivals its entire stock market value. But the real question is whether this buying spree moves the price of ETH or simply makes BMNR a turbocharged bet on a coin that has already lost half its value from peak.
data.keywords: Thomas Lee, Bitmine, Ethereum, corporate treasury, market value
